ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, it is known that $AB \parallel CD$, $\angle 1 = \angle 2$, $\angle E = 50^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle F$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw line BC, \\
$\because$AB$\parallel$CD, \\
$\therefore$$\angle$ABC=$\angle$BCD, \\
$\because$$\angle$1=$\angle$2, \\
$\therefore$$\angle$EBC=$\angle$BCF, \\
$\therefore$EB$\parallel$CF, \\
$\therefore$$\angle$F=$\angle$E=$50^\circ$. \\
Therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{50^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: AB is the upper horizontal segment, CD is the lower horizontal segment, and the broken line B-E-F-C connects the two; angle 1 is at B between AB and BE, angle 2 is at C between CF and CD, angle E is at vertex E, and angle F is at vertex F. Read from the text that AB ∥ CD, ∠1 = ∠2, and ∠E = 50°. Add an auxiliary segment BC. Since AB ∥ CD, transversal BC gives ∠ABC = ∠BCD. In the diagram, ∠ABC is split into ∠1 plus ∠EBC, while ∠BCD is split into ∠2 plus ∠BCF. Because ∠1 = ∠2, subtract equal angles to get ∠EBC = ∠BCF. Therefore EB ∥ CF by the converse of the alternate interior/corresponding angle theorem. With EF as a transversal of the parallel lines EB and CF, ∠F = ∠E = 50°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中上方是一条水平线段 AB，A 在左、B 在右；下方是一条水平线段 CD，C 在左、D 在右。折线从 B 斜向左下到 E，再斜向右下到 F，再斜向左下到 C。∠1 标在 B 附近，是 AB 与 BE 形成的角；∠2 标在 C 附近，是 CF 与 CD 形成的角；∠E 是顶点 E 处的角，∠F 是顶点 F 处的角。题设给出 AB ∥ CD，∠1 = ∠2，且 ∠E = 50°。
推理：按方法作辅助线 BC。因为 AB ∥ CD，BC 是截线，所以 ∠ABC = ∠BCD。由图形位置，∠ABC 可分成 ∠1 和 ∠EBC，∠BCD 可分成 ∠2 和 ∠BCF。又因为 ∠1 = ∠2，所以从相等的总角中减去相等的部分，得到 ∠EBC = ∠BCF。因此 EB ∥ CF。再以 EF 为截线，平行线 EB 与 CF 所成的对应角相等，所以 ∠F = ∠E = 50°。
